task: Generate one photorealistic still frame in the style of a casual vertical selfie video in which the same woman from the attached reference image talks to her audience from her home office. The attached reference image shows this exact woman sitting in her car: keep her identity exactly the same (same face, facial features, skin tone, skin texture with its natural freckles and small imperfections, eyes, brows and hair), and only change the location, clothes, pose and camera setup described below. It will be used as the first frame of a talking-head video, so it should feel candid and authentic, like a frame from an everyday phone video, not a posed photo.

output.look: candid phone front-camera video frame, slightly imperfect, not a professional photo

subject.identity: exactly the same original fictional woman as in the attached reference image, around 30 years old
subject.face: identical to the reference: same light warm skin with natural freckles, small blemishes and visible pores, same dark brown eyes and brows, same bare, natural no-makeup look with soft nude lips
subject.hair: same dark brown hair as the reference, pulled back loosely in a low bun, a few loose strands framing the face
subject.accessories: the same medium gold hoop earrings as in the reference

wardrobe.top: comfortable oversized oatmeal-colored knit sweater, soft fabric with natural folds
wardrobe.style: cozy at-home clothes, relaxed and natural, no visible logos

pose_and_expression.position: seated at her desk, facing the phone, leaning very slightly toward the camera
pose_and_expression.gaze: looking directly into the lens, making eye contact with the viewer
pose_and_expression.expression: relaxed and self-assured, a very subtle closed-mouth smile, as if about to start talking; calm, no teeth
pose_and_expression.hands: both hands resting relaxed on the desk in the lower part of the frame, natural fingers, correct anatomy

environment.location: her bright, modern home office, during the day
environment.background: warm white wall, a light wooden shelf with a few books and a small plant, a soft linen curtain at one edge, a cozy and tidy space, softly out of focus
environment.foreground: an open silver laptop on a light wooden desk at the lower edge of the frame, its screen angled away (no readable content), next to a ceramic coffee mug
environment.atmosphere: calm, warm, real lived-in home workspace, not a studio set

camera.device: phone front camera propped on the desk in front of her, at chest-to-eye height, slightly below eye level and slightly off to one side (gentle three-quarter angle, not perfectly straight-on)
camera.lens: wide-angle selfie lens (about 24mm equivalent) with its natural mild perspective
camera.framing: medium close-up from the waist up, head in the upper-middle of the frame (eyes at about 38% of the frame height from the top), the laptop visible at the bottom, clean wall space above her head for on-screen graphics
camera.focus: face sharp, background softly in focus as a phone would render it (no artificial heavy bokeh)
camera.quality: 1080x1920 vertical video frame, slight sensor noise, mild compression, true-to-life colors

lighting.key: soft, diffused daylight from a large window directly in front of her, behind the phone, lighting her whole face evenly
lighting.mood: bright, warm and natural; both sides of the face evenly lit, no side shadows, accurate skin tones, low contrast

realism_rules: candid, authentic everyday phone video look, not a stock photo
same natural skin texture as the reference, no smoothing or beauty filter
natural folds on the knit sweater
correct anatomy: two hands, five fingers each, natural proportions
natural catchlights in the eyes from the window in front of her
negative: a different face, a different person, changed facial features or hairstyle
text, captions, subtitles, logos, watermarks, UI elements, readable laptop screen
big smile showing teeth, exaggerated expression, posing
side lighting, one half of the face darker than the other, harsh direct sunlight, strong shadows
studio lighting, ring light reflections, cinematic color grading, heavy bokeh
extra or deformed fingers, distorted hands, warped face
plastic skin, makeup that is not in the reference, 3D render, cartoon, illustration
sunglasses, glasses, cluttered desk, other people
